title: Biased influence and a Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f$ be a monotone function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Under the product distribution in which each sign has bias parameter $p$, the influence of $f$ at coordinate $i$ equals $\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$ times the biased Fourier coefficient of its real-valued sign representation indexed by the singleton $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the two signs
